property_summary: For any caller that is the current owner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) always makes C.owner() equal to the provided newOwner; the mutant instead sets owner to msg.sender, so there exist inputs (owner != newOwner) where this rule is violated.
change_summary: Replace the assignment 'owner = newOwner;' with assigning owner to msg.sender (keeps owner unchanged when caller is already owner, or reverts intended transfer), changing resulting owner after call.
